title: Barn Preparation and Disinfection
content: Before day-old chicks arrive, the poultry barn must be completely cleared of old litter, power-washed under pressure, and sanitized. Whitewashing walls with 20% slaked lime significantly reduces bacterial load. Turn on heaters 24 hours prior to placement so the floor and bedding reach 32-33°C. The dry bedding (wood shavings) should be at least 5–7 cm deep.

quiz.question: What floor/bedding temperature is required upon day-old chick placement?
quiz.explanation: Bedding temperature must reach 32-33°C at placement to prevent hypothermia and yolk sac infections.
